correctness.rationale: For noninteger-half flux the energies 2J cos((2pi k+phi)/n) are simple and all modes overlap the single absorber; full decay follows from nonexistence of dark eigenmodes. Integrated Lyapunov equation for X=int rho gives exact rank-one absorber identity T=n/kappa+(2kappa/n²)sum_{j<k}(E_j-E_k)^-2. Even-cycle parity d=j-k,s=j+k and differentiated cotangent multiplication identity evaluate to two csc² terms. Strict convexity of a/x+b/(1-x) yields the two reflected flux minimizers and jointly optimal kappa. At 0,pi capture ranks count distinct energies and unconditional T diverges. Independently solved 20 full complex Lyapunov systems for n=4..12, 4 off-resonance phases, matching formula; not an infinite proof.
